text: Handling deadlines is an important skill that can reduce stress and improve your results. First, good time management helps you plan your tasks and avoid last-minute panic. Second, prioritization means deciding which tasks are most urgent and doing them first. Third, scope management is about being realistic and not taking on more work than you can finish on time. Finally, communication matters: if you see a problem, tell your team or manager early so they can help. By following these simple steps, you can meet deadlines more easily and feel more confident at work or school.
